title: Titanker Metal Shower Curtain Hooks Rings Durable Rust Resistant Shower Curtain Hooks with Double Glide Castors for Bathroom Shower Rods Set of 12 Hooks Nickel Plated

reviews.title: Not rust resistant
reviews.body: They are easy to install and provide very smooth traction initially.  However, they are not rust resistant at all.  All rusted with a few months and then they are spoiling my shower curtain too.
reviews.author: FT

reviews.title: Perfect solution
reviews.body: We purchased these together with a clear liner curtain and a decorative fabric shower curtain. These hooks allow us to hang both curtains on one hook but keep them separate to allow the liner to be inside the shower and the decorative curtain outside the shower. This will facilitate easy replacement of the liner and/or the decorative curtain seperatly for cleaning or replacing. The rollers on the hooks make it very easy to pull the cutains across with very little effort.
reviews.author: Aeron W

reviews.title: Good product.
reviews.body: The product was good. The seller was great (understanding and cooperative).
reviews.date: Reviewed in Saudi Arabia on 26 August 2024
reviews.author: abdullah alramadhan

reviews.title: Best with heft
reviews.body: I was gonna take two stars since if you just use a liner, the light weight of it even a good one causes theses things to jump around and sometimes off. Once I got a shower curtain of good heft. The waffle one that sells a lot on amazon, the combo now works perfect. Easy slide and no problems. I like the look and the double hook is great and easy. Great design should last long enough to forget you bought them till you get another set
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 11 July 2026
reviews.author: Biff Worthington

reviews.title: Highly recommend purchasing.
reviews.body: Fantastic product, Looks just like advertised, Easy to use, glides with ease. Highly recommend purchasing.
reviews.author: Marcus A. Pecchenino Jr

features: SMOOTH SLIDING The specially designed spherical rollers of shower curtain hooks glide smoothly and quickly across the shower rod.
Double hooks design - The double roller glide shower curtain hooks are strong enough to hold up a heavy curtain or shower liner.
High quality metal - These double glided shower curtain rings with double hooks are made of high quality and selected metal, which is particularly resistant to rust.
Plated & polished: The double hooks for shower curtains are polished and feature a lacquer coating, making them an elegant decoration in your bathroom.
SET OF 12 - Sold as a set of 12 shower curtain rings. Titanker shower curtain hooks set meets most quantity requirements for a normal bathroom.
